symptoms_and_damage: Rosette flowers ('rosetted bloom'), entrance hole sealed by larva, destruction of seed and lint within green bolls
economic_threshold_level: 8 moths/trap/night for 3 consecutive days or 10% green boll damage
biological_control: Pheromone traps (Phero-sensor) and inundative release of Trichogramma bactrae wasps weekly
cultural_control: Install 5-8 pheromone traps/acre for monitoring; destruct crop residue right after final harvest; no ratoon cropping
chemical_guidance: Indoxacarb 14.5 SC (0.5ml/L) or Flubendiamide 39.35 SC (0.3ml/L) per extension guidelines

symptoms_and_damage: Window-pane holes on young leaves, extensive defoliation, deep boring into whorl with sawdust-like frass
economic_threshold_level: 1 damaged plant out of 10 at early stage or 1 larva/plant
biological_control: Nomuraea rileyi or Metarhizium anisopliae biopesticide; Trichogramma egg parasitoids
cultural_control: Push-pull technology using Napier grass and Desmodium; handpick egg masses in small plots
chemical_guidance: Emamectin benzoate 5 SG (0.4g/L) or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC (0.4ml/L) whorl application per local rules

symptoms_and_damage: Severe sap sucking at stem base causing circular patches of dry brown burnt plants ('hopperburn')
economic_threshold_level: 1-2 insects per tiller at vegetative stage or 5-10/tiller at heading
biological_control: Release spiders (Lycosa pseudoannulata) and mirid bugs (Cyrtorhinus lividipennis)
cultural_control: Drain field water for 3-4 days ('alternate wetting and drying'); avoid excess urea
chemical_guidance: Pymetrozine 50 WG (0.6g/L) or Triflumezopyrim 10 SC (0.5ml/L) applied targeted to plant base

symptoms_and_damage: Yellowing and chlorosis of foliage, transmitting debilitating viruses (Leaf Curl, Yellow Mosaic)
economic_threshold_level: 6-8 adults per leaf on top 3 leaves
biological_control: Chrysoperla carnea predators and Verticillium lecanii entomopathogenic fungus
cultural_control: Yellow sticky traps (20/acre) at canopy level; barrier crops of sorghum or maize around borders
chemical_guidance: Diafenthiuron 50 WP (1g/L) or Spiromesifen 22.9 SC (1ml/L) as recommended by district farm center

symptoms_and_damage: Dead heart at vegetative stage (drying of central tiller) and whitehead at heading stage (empty panicle)
economic_threshold_level: 1 egg mass per square meter or 5% dead hearts
biological_control: Release egg parasitoid Trichogramma japonicum @ 50, 000/ha weekly
cultural_control: Clipping of seedling leaf tips before planting to eliminate egg masses; light traps at night
chemical_guidance: Cartap hydrochloride 4G (10kg/acre) or Chlorantraniliprole 0.4% GR applied in standing water

symptoms_and_damage: Curling of tender young leaves, stunted shoots, sticky honeydew secretion with black sooty mold
economic_threshold_level: 20-25 aphids per shoot or 10% infested plants
biological_control: Encourage ladybird beetles (Coccinella septempunctata) and hoverfly larvae
cultural_control: Install yellow sticky traps (15-20 per acre); spray neem oil 5ml/liter with mild soap
chemical_guidance: Thiamethoxam 25 WG (0.3g/L) or Imidacloprid 17.8 SL (0.4ml/L) only under expert supervision

symptoms_and_damage: Upward curling of leaves, silvery white patches with necrotic spots on undersurface ('bronzing')
economic_threshold_level: 5-10 thrips per leaf
biological_control: Blue sticky traps (prefer blue over yellow for thrips); neem oil 3ml/L
cultural_control: Sprinkler irrigation to wash off nymphs; avoid excessive synthetic pyrethroids
chemical_guidance: Spinosad 45 SC (0.3ml/L) or Fipronil 5 SC (1.5ml/L) applied strictly per agricultural protocol

symptoms_and_damage: Wilting of growing shoot tips, holes bored into fruits/pods with larval excreta, unmarketable harvest
economic_threshold_level: 5% affected shoots or 1-2 bored fruits/pods per plant
biological_control: Helicoverpa armigera NPV (HaNPV @ 250 LE/ha) viral spray; release Bracon hebetor wasps
cultural_control: Clip and bury withered shoots weekly; install sex pheromone traps at 12 per hectare
chemical_guidance: Coragen (Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 0.3ml/L) or Flubendiamide 480 SC within harvest safety interval

symptoms_and_damage: Small shot-holes chewed through leaf blade giving a sieve-like appearance, flower petal eating
economic_threshold_level: 2-3 beetles per meter row
biological_control: Diatomaceous earth dusting over foliage; parasitic nematodes for soil larvae
cultural_control: Row covers during seedling establishment; trap crops of radish or mustard along borders
chemical_guidance: Azadirachtin spray (1500 ppm @ 4ml/L) or contact formulation per local farm doctor advice

symptoms_and_damage: Boring into stem medulla causing zig-zag reddish-brown tunnel, wilting and drying of plants
economic_threshold_level: 10% infested plants at vegetative stage
biological_control: Conserve natural braconid parasitoids; spray 5% neem seed kernel extract (NSKE)
cultural_control: Early sowing; seed treatment with bio-agents; crop rotation
chemical_guidance: Thiamethoxam 30 FS seed treatment (10ml/kg seed) or spray Thiamethoxam 25 WG

symptoms_and_damage: Fine silken webbing on leaf undersides, yellowish speckling, bronzing, drying and premature defoliation
economic_threshold_level: 5-8 mites per leaf
biological_control: Release predatory phytoseiid mites (Amblyseius spp.); sulfur dust
cultural_control: Avoid water stress; spray cold water jets under leaves to break silken webbing
chemical_guidance: Spiromesifen 22.9 SC (1ml/L) or Propargite 57 EC (2ml/L) under agronomist guidance

symptoms_and_damage: Dead heart at early tillering stage that pulls out easily emitting foul decomposing odor
economic_threshold_level: 15% dead hearts at 30-90 days after planting
biological_control: Release Trichogramma chilonis egg parasitoids @ 50, 000/ha every 10 days
cultural_control: Earthing up at 30-45 days after planting; trash mulching between cane rows (10 cm thick)
chemical_guidance: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC (0.4ml/L) spray over rows or Fipronil 0.3% GR in furrow

symptoms_and_damage: Sap sucking on tender flushes producing white waxy secretions; vector of devastating Citrus Greening (HLB)
economic_threshold_level: 5 psyllids per shoot
biological_control: Encourage parasitic wasp Tamarixia radiata; spray horticultural mineral oil (1%)
cultural_control: Prune unseasonal shoots; synchronize flush emergence with regulated irrigation
chemical_guidance: Thiamethoxam 25 WG (0.3g/L) or Dimethoate 30 EC (1.5ml/L) during active flush stage

symptoms_and_damage: Silvery zig-zag serpentine mines beneath leaf cuticle, curling of young leaves, predisposes to citrus canker
economic_threshold_level: 10% infested tender leaves
biological_control: Spray 5% neem seed kernel extract (NSKE) or Beauveria bassiana
cultural_control: Prune water sprouts and late autumn flushes; remove heavily mined young foliage
chemical_guidance: Abamectin 1.9 EC (0.5ml/L) or Spinosad 45 SC (0.3ml/L) at flush emergence

symptoms_and_damage: Dense colonies covering inflorescence, pods and leaves, sucking sap leading to curled shoots and poor seed set
economic_threshold_level: 50-60 aphids per 10 cm terminal twig
biological_control: Encourage green lacewings and ladybird beetle grubs; spray 5% NSKE
cultural_control: Early sowing in October to escape peak aphid flight; maintain yellow water pan traps
chemical_guidance: Dimethoate 30 EC (1.5ml/L) or Oxydemeton-methyl 25 EC applied in late evening

symptoms_and_damage: Holes in pods, larvae feeding on developing green grains inside pods; grain hollowed out
economic_threshold_level: 5-8% pod damage or 1 larva per plant
biological_control: Erect bird perches @ 25/acre; spray HaNPV @ 250 LE/ha
cultural_control: Intercrop with sorghum or pearl millet; shake plants over cloth sheet to collect larvae
chemical_guidance: Indoxacarb 14.5 SC (0.75ml/L) or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC (0.3ml/L) at 50% flowering

symptoms_and_damage: Skeletonized leaves by young larvae, large irregular holes chewed in foliage; cutting seedlings at base
economic_threshold_level: 1 egg mass or 2 larvae per meter row
biological_control: Nomuraea rileyi or SlNPV (Spodoptera NPV @ 250 LE/ha) biological spray
cultural_control: Deploy sex pheromone traps (Spodolure @ 5/acre); handpick gregarious young larvae from leaves
chemical_guidance: Novoluron 10 EC (1.5ml/L) or Emamectin benzoate 5 SG (0.4g/L) targeted to foliage

symptoms_and_damage: Small pinhead holes on lower pseudostem with transparent gelatinous gummy exudate; stem rotting
economic_threshold_level: 5 adult weevils per longitudinal pseudostem trap
biological_control: Deploy split pseudostem disc traps smeared with Beauveria bassiana spores
cultural_control: Maintain clean plantation hygiene; remove dried sheaths; destroy old harvested pseudostems
chemical_guidance: Swabbing of stem with Chlorpyrifos 20 EC (2.5ml/L) or stem injection under expert protocol

symptoms_and_damage: Thick white waxy cotton-like colonies clustered on growing shoots, terminal distortion, sooty mold
economic_threshold_level: 1-2 infested plants per 50 plants surveyed
biological_control: Release predatory ladybird beetles (Cryptolaemus montrouzieri) and Encyrtid parasitoids
cultural_control: Destroy alternate weed hosts (Parthenium, Abutilon); avoid transporting infested plant parts
chemical_guidance: Buprofezin 25 SC (2ml/L) or Profenofos 50 EC (2ml/L) with wetting agent to dissolve wax

symptoms_and_damage: Hollowing out of germinating seed setts/seeds and root systems; lodging of mature plants
economic_threshold_level: 5% dead plants showing severed root bases
biological_control: Soil application of Metarhizium anisopliae bio-formulation
cultural_control: Deep summer plowing; remove un-decomposed farmyard manure and dry crop stubble from soil
chemical_guidance: Seed treatment with Chlorpyrifos 20 EC (4ml/kg seed) or Fipronil 5 SC (2ml/kg)
